title: Base WriteProperty variant 3 revised
purpose: Exercise a conservative confirmed WriteProperty request with a compact real-valued property payload and explicit priority while keeping nested tags and total frame length internally consistent.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP server should parse the frame as a confirmed WriteProperty request and then return an acknowledgment or a protocol-conforming error depending on object, property, value, and access state.
constraints_preserved: BVLC uses BACnet/IP original-unicast framing with a four-byte header
BVLC total length 0x0019 matches the full encoded message length
NPDU precedes the confirmed-request APDU and service parameters
Opening and closing tags in the property value portion are balanced
Hex is lowercase and has an even number of characters
issue_safety_notes: No vulnerability issue knowledge is used. This is a conservative model-prior seed for parser and operation coverage only.
